description: List the WebMCP tools the page declares for agents: name, description, input_schema, origin, kind (imperative = registered with document.modelContext.registerTool; declarative = a <form toolname>), sensitive (why webmcp_call wants confirm) and how many times each was called. active=false: WebMCP is off in this Chrome and only form tools are visible, as plain forms. calls adds the call log of the page, any caller (chrome-bridge or the browser agent): input, output, status, ms.

calls.description: Also return the last N calls from the log; 0 = tools only

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: webmcp_tools
